niche.habitat: Upper atmosphere, below cloud deck, within day-to-night return flow.
niche.diet: Condensation nuclei, aerosolized nitrate, IR-scavenging microbes.
niche.active: Continuous gliding; flares trigger feeding frenzy and NOx absorption.

body: Kite-like membrane, long tail, gas bladder, near-infrared crest sensors.

links: Wings generate lift in 50-60 m/s flow
Weak Coriolis pins large wind systems

skill.effect: The creature glides effortlessly across the landscape for a short while, riding rising air currents to climb higher into the sky.

chains.weakness: Wing shear in turbulence; player can use 'Storm' skill to damage flight.
observe: Wings held rigid against return wind
Altañuela circling in upper air columns

links: Skin fixes atmospheric nitrogen from NOx
Nitrate rains out after flare events

journal.en: The air holds it like water.

moments: A flock of Altañuela silhouettes against the fixed star, crest sensors pulsing as a flare warning triggers a collective dive into the cloud deck, where they feast on the falling nitrogen.

journal.en: The sky is a river of wind.
